effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: You can only activate this card when there are 1 or more "Harpie Lady" on the field. Special Summon 1 "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" from your hand or your Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the GOAT script's s.activate finds no "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" in hand or Deck it reveals both zones to prove the whiff (else-branch Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. The printed text is untouched by this procedure.

changes.historical_text: You can only activate this card when there are 1 or more "Harpie Lady" on the field. Special Summon 1 "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" from your hand or your Deck.
changes.summary: Era activation semantics, separate from the verification procedure: the GOAT s.target keeps only the free-Monster-Zone check (Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0) and drops the modern script's Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(...,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK,...), so the Spell can be activated with no Harpie to Special Summon. No source in the packet dates the end of this per-card allowance, so its chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline text matches lineage v2 (DB1-EN156, Dark Beginning 1, 2004-10-12) exactly - the text in force at the GOAT snapshot. The later lineage is treated as cosmetic: v3 (SD8-EN021, 2006-07-12) inserts "face-up" before "Harpie Lady", but upstream's GOAT variant leaves the condition function untouched and the shared s.cfilter already requires c:IsFaceup(), so no behavioural difference is encoded on either side of that printing; v4 (RP01-EN029, 2008-07-08), v5 (Legendary Collection, 2010-10-01) and v6 (LCJW-EN098, 2013-10-11) are wording/PSCT passes. Remaining script diffs are style only (LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK vs +, the if/else restructure of s.activate that hosts the GoatConfirm branch). Upstream ships one GOAT script encoding both ruling behaviours, so no implementation exists for a state in which only one had changed, and with (B) undated the pair cannot be sequenced. Not listed on EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata page.
